plan.notes: CAVEATS: (1) The official 25-26 guide PDF is watermarked '(DRAFT)' and mixes names ('Modern Policy'/'Modern Policing', 'Associate of Arts'/'AS' in headers); the award is transcribed as Modern Policing AS per the guide body text and the current program listing. (2) The 46-unit major counts specifically-required GE courses (ENGLC1000, STATC1000, COMMC1000, ENGLC1001, PHIL105, ART103) inside the major total: 24 (complete-all) + 3 (AJ elective) + 3 (AJ206/CFE103) + 16 (five GE courses, STATC1000 at 4 units) = 46. (3) The requirements list prints STATC1000 as 3 units but the Semester 1 pathway lists it as 4 units (3+3+4+3+2=15); transcribed as 4 per the pathway, which is also what makes the 46-unit major total work. (4) Each 'Required Courses: Choose one of the following' GE line is modeled as a regular-vs-Honors choice, since the Recommended Plan of Study includes all five courses. Degree requirements: 60 units, 18+ in major, 21 AVC GE, 2.0 GPA, C or better in major. Prepares graduates for CA AB 89 peace-officer core competencies. Guide dated 7/18/25 (Angie Gonzalez).
